desc: The DPMS DP-15 Shortacle is a compact AR-style pistol chambered in 5.56 and built for maneuverability and modern modularity. This platform features a 10.5 inch barrel with a carbine-length gas system and a lightweight M-Lok handguard, delivering a balanced setup suited for close-quarters handling. Designed with a CAR-style adjustable blade brace, it offers a compact footprint while maintaining familiar AR ergonomics.
